purpose: Execute the two already specified v1 full-learning mechanism controls after the failed paired-feedback TRAIN probe. Not a fifth main method, not an extra independent main/ACE/Text repeat.
one_scientific_config_difference: skill_commit_policy; identity/protocol/contrast annotations are administrative differences
initial_bank_and_request_cache: empty separately for both controls; no historical answer, teacher, or score import
program:
import fcntl,json,os,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.openexempt_online import Online,preserve
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import read,sha,now
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore

plan_path=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
plan=read(plan_path)
root=Path.cwd()
chain=plan_path.parent
completed=[]
def progress(stage,**kw):
    RunStore.atomic_json(chain/"progress.json",{"at":now(),"stage":stage,**kw})
try:
    assert sha(root/"experiments/openexempt_online.py")==plan["expected_core_sha256"]
    assert sha(root/"tests/test_openexempt_contract.py")==plan["expected_contract_test_sha256"]
    stat=Path("/proc/958223/stat").read_text().rsplit(")",1)[1].split()
    assert stat[19]=="486445918"
    assert not Path("/proc/4105189").exists()
    prior=read(root/plan["completed_probe_receipt"])
    assert all(sha(v["path"])==v["sha256"] for v in prior["paths"])
    v2=read(root/plan["v2_source_preservation_receipt"])
    assert all(sha(v["path"])==v["sha256"] for v in v2["paths"])
    identity={"at":now(),"pid":os.getpid(),"birth_ticks":Path(f"/proc/{os.getpid()}/stat").read_text().rsplit(")",1)[1].split()[19],
              "model_pid":958223,"model_birth_ticks":"486445918","plan_sha256":sha(plan_path),"extra_independent_repeats":"USER-DEFERRED"}
    RunStore.immutable_json(chain/"execution_identity.json",identity)
    with (root/"artifacts/openexempt_training.lock").open("a") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        for config in plan["configs"]:
            path=root/config
            assert sha(path)==plan["config_sha256"][config]
            cfg=read(path)
            progress("running_prebound_same_version_policy_control",run_id=cfg["run_id"],policy=cfg["skill_commit_policy"],completed=completed)
            study=Online(path)
            assert study.bank==[] and study.request_cache=={}
            study.run()
            result=read(study.out/"completion.json")
            receipt=read(study.out/"terminal_preservation.json")
            assert len(receipt["paths"])==2 and all(sha(v["path"])==v["sha256"] for v in receipt["paths"])
            completed.append({"run_id":cfg["run_id"],"status":result["status"],"closed_batches":len(result["batch_summary"]),
                              "actual_native_calls":result["actual_native_calls"],"actual_teacher_responses":result["actual_teacher_responses"],
                              "terminal_receipt":str((study.out/"terminal_preservation.json").relative_to(root))})
    RunStore.immutable_json(chain/"completion.json",{"at":now(),"status":"completed_prebound_policy_control_queue","controls":completed,
        "both_complete_eight_batches":all(x["closed_batches"]==8 for x in completed),"prospective_TEST_opened":False,"not_goal_completion":True})
    progress("terminal",completed=completed)
except BaseException as exc:
    RunStore.immutable_json(chain/"failure.json",{"at":now(),"error":repr(exc),"traceback":traceback.format_exc(),"completed":completed,
        "no_retry_fallback_or_method_substitution":True})
    raise
finally:
    names={str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in chain.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    names.update(plan["configs"])
    names.update(str((root/p).with_suffix(".frozen.json").relative_to(root)) for p in plan["configs"])
    if names:
        RunStore.immutable_json(chain/"terminal_preservation.json",preserve(plan["queue_id"],"actual-terminal",sorted(names)))
